scope: Source-only prioritization of original Solr checks other than SOLR-05, SOLR-09, SOLR-14, SOLR-18, SOLR-31, SOLR-36, and SOLR-37
evidence_basis: Existing data/mallory/calibration_v4 healthy calibration results and exact Solr 8.11.4 source; no new JVM test executed
newer_receipt_coverage: The available v10 and v13 Solr result sets do not contain these five cases; v4 is their latest local healthy calibration receipt.
interpretation: A valid healthy seed and closure edge fingerprint count do not alone prove that an injectable I/O door is causally connected to the exact target guard. Confirm the observed target occurrence and its backward I/O closure before fault trials.

target.guard: core == null; throws SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE at line 1326

recommended.source_path: The test creates a collection and asynchronously adds NRT, TLOG, and PULL replicas at lines 63-72. Core registration waits for replica state through ZkStateReader.waitForState at ZkController.java:1265-1268, obtains the leader at line 1310, then obtains the core immediately before the line 1325 guard.
recommended.practical_note: The same enabled selector covers SOLR-19; the core lookup at line 1323 is the nearest guard dependency to inspect.

target.guard: nonlegacy mode and cloud descriptor coreNodeName == null; throws at line 1330

recommended.source_path: The asynchronous ADDREPLICA request at test lines 67-72 leads to core creation. CoreContainer.create checks the CloudDescriptor identity before checkIfCoreNodeNameAlreadyExists and coresLocator.create at source lines 1333-1338; the upstream collection command and ZK-provided replica identity are the plausible I/O dependency.
recommended.practical_note: The guard occurs before direct I/O in create, so prioritize an observed parent command or descriptor-origin edge rather than a later coresLocator door.

target.guard: commit is deleted or requested generation is older than latest commit; throws at line 177

recommended.source_path: The test creates PULL replicas, adds and commits documents, restarts a replica, and waits for replication at lines 219-245. IndexFetcher.fetchFileList sends an HTTP GET_FILE_LIST request with a generation at IndexFetcher.java:343-357; ReplicationHandler.getFileList invokes getAndSaveCommitPoint for a nonnegative generation at ReplicationHandler.java:655-669.
recommended.practical_note: Strongest source-level HTTP-to-guard route in this set; the test includes replica restart and timed replication, so it may cost more per run.

target.guard: isLeader && replica type is PULL; assertion fails at line 1315

recommended.source_path: The test creates two shards with PULL replicas through one of three collection API variants at lines 130-162 and verifies PULL replicas are not leaders at lines 166-179. Registration waits for ZK replica state at ZkController.java:1265-1268 and asks for the leader at line 1310 immediately before the line 1315 assertion.
recommended.practical_note: The test has @Repeat(iterations=2) and randomizes its collection API variant. Its valid v4 receipt shows the repeated run is accepted by the current runner.

target.guard: replica == null; assertion fails at line 1765

recommended.source_path: The test creates a collection, sends reloadCollection at lines 52-59, then expires a ZK session and waits for re-registration at lines 72-79. CoreContainer.reload obtains the collection through ZkController.getClusterState at line 1736, registers the new core at line 1743, and retrieves the replica immediately before the assertion at lines 1763-1765.
recommended.practical_note: Exact assertion is reached, but the state lookup may use an in-memory ZK cache. Verify an observed reload parent or ZK door in the target closure before injecting.

deferred.reason: Both have valid v4 healthy seeds, but SOLR-01 has zero closure edge fingerprints and its line 243 retry guard precedes the HTTP alias fetch in the same loop iteration; SOLR-38 has only six closure edge fingerprints and a broad update path. Both are weaker immediate I/O-to-guard candidates than the five ranked cases.

Existing routed-alias update test hierarchy is disabled by @AwaitsFix and @Ignore. Enabled alias creation tests found in source do not also add a document through the routed-alias update path. Existing v10 healthy seed attempts are invalid.
Prior exact-guard source audit classifies these as infeasible for a healthy nonthrowing seed reaching the requested check; see Mallory/cases/solr_test_mapping_recommendations.md.
